# POST /api/v1/repos/{template_owner}/{template_repo}/generate

Create a repository using a template

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer · **ID:** `ep-364`

- **403** — User not allowed to create repo for target owner

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Repository creation applies ForcePrivate setting override | business_logic | setting.Repository.ForcePrivate is true |
| Generate repo requires admin or org membership to create for other users | authorization | Target owner is different from doer and doer is not admin |
| Generate repo requires at least one template option to be selected | validation | No template items selected (all booleans false) |

### Error Paths

- **Not a template repo** → repo.Generate → 422
- **No template items selected** → repo.Generate → 422
- **Owner not found** → repo.Generate → 404
- **Not admin and target is other user** → repo.Generate → 403
- **Repo already exists** → repo.Generate → 409
